credit_line: Gift of the Andrew Smith Gallery
description: Black and white unframed photograph of Georgia O'Keeffe seated by the window of the living room of her Abiquiu house.  In the upper right corner is visible a portion of the Calder sculpture.  In the lower right in black ink is a signature "Waugh 72".  Photo is mounted to board, which is signed on the back on the upper left corner in red ink "Lynn Waugh" and in black ink "for Susan".
title: Portrait of O'Keeffe Seated in Livingroom of Abiquiu house
